ios.desc:
Sleep train with confidence.

Lizzy is the easiest way to sleep train your 3-20 month old. Created by a mom of 4 and sleep consultant, Lizzy draws on years of successful sleep consultations to bring your whole family better sleep.

Parents who dive in see even the most stubborn sleeper achieve more independent sleep in *days* not months. Don't just believe us, read our reviews!


* Key Features* 

- 24/7 Real-Time AI Chat with Lizzy (Powered by Expert Human Sleep Consultants)

Get immediate answers. Other sleep solutions give you generic tips, but Lizzy gives you personalized support based on YOUR child. This is key to helping you stick with a plan! Whether it’s nap schedules or middle-of-the-night wake-ups, Lizzy is always available to support you as your personal sleep consultant.

- Sleep Tracking Reimagined

"I want to see more charts and numbers to analyze!" - said no parent ever. Lizzy's sleep tracking is a real conversation. Just start a nap or bedtime timer, and Lizzy joins you - offering gentle feedback and encouragement along the way. She'll offer dynamic schedules that adapt to your reality - not a canned schedule for a theoretical baby. Plus, see sleep sessions live on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island for effortless peace of mind. Lizzy empowers you as a parent to learn, adapt, and enjoy your little one. 
 
- Short & Sweet Sleep Plan

No fluff, endless Googling, or long PDFs - just a focused plan to help you see results in days. Perfect for busy parents who need quick wins and sustainable habits.

Risk free trial
Download for free and begin with a free trial. Cancel anytime - no hidden fees, no surprises.

Weekly & Monthly Options
Choose an affordable plan that fits your timeline. Sleep training can be successful in just a few days to weeks if you're ready, so we have a weekly plan that supports it. Choose monthly or longer subscriptions for ongoing support for regressions, new situations, and 'sleep maintenance'.

* What can Lizzy help me with? *

Lizzy is designed to first help you sleep train your child for independent bedtime. From there, with good sleep hygiene, you can work on sleeping through the night, independent naps, extending naps, and getting rid of early morning wakes. All in a safe, age appropriate manner. Lizzy's plan guides you through the fundamentals, and the 24/7 chat with Lizzy helps give you the confidence you're on the right track.

quotes.text:
Hey HN

I’m excited to show Lizzy Sleep - an app designed to help you sleep train your child (3 mths - 2 years). It’s free to try on the App Store (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/lizzy-sleep/id6478873750?ign-itscg=30200&ign-itsct=apps_box_link).

Loom if you don't want to download: https://www.loom.com/share/69ecca3afd094ec7be420d809ccbb6bf?sid=ba223809-ef25-4270-b517-ce952e89561a

Backstory:

My wife and I had our first child in 2020. We knew we didn’t want to co-sleep and needed our personal sleep and boundaries. As our son got older and heavier, rocking him to sleep was getting unmanageable. It hurt our backs and we had no free time.

We looked up tons of information about sleep training all over the internet and even bought some expensive PDFs teaching us stuff… but it all led to us being more confused in the end. There was conflicting information out there on the internet, and most of all there was no feedback loop and help when you’re unsure of what you’re doing.

We eventually discovered sleep consulting through https://sleepbabyconsulting.com. A consultant gives you 1:1 help based on your family and preferences, puts together a personalized sleep plan and information for you, and then gives you troubleshooting support over text/calls for a few weeks.

In a matter of a week our son went from needing to be rocked for every single nap/bedtime, to being a completely independent sleeper. That kid’s now 4.5 and he’s still a great sleeper!
